checkpoint_rule: max validation macro-F1, then min validation cross-entropy
ag_selection: highest mean validation macro-F1 over three seeds, then lowest mean validation cross-entropy; locked before test evaluation
crop_policy: five deterministic overlapping corner/center crops, same for all region variants; not a detector or verified anatomical grounding
attribute_bank: 58 source-derived visual descriptors; no test images or test labels used in descriptions
training: Frozen visual and text encoders, trained projection and 128-dimensional fusion; equal steps, batches, learning rate and seed across variants
statistics: Report all variants; paired McNemar and paired image bootstrap for three-seed probability ensembles; Holm correction across 15 settings times 2 reference comparisons
claim: AG-CLIP-inspired development variants, not exact original-paper reproduction; gains and statistical significance are not guaranteed
